column3: Saori Route ・ Venturing Into Akiba Once Again
Ah, ah, ah...
What's wrong? How did the plan go?
aouaouaouaou!
I don't understand what you're saying!
Right now, I can't leave Saori like this.
I have to get her to calm down and listen to me.
Listen, okay? Right now, you need to cool off.
At times like these, you breathe in-
*breathes in*
Breathe in.
*breathes in*
Breathe in, breathe in, breathe in!
*breathes in*
Breathe in!!!!
*breathes in*, *cough* *cough* *cough*
A-Are you trying to kill me!?
But hey, it calmed you down, right?
aouaouaouaouaou!
Don't go back to that!
aouaouaouaou...!
Cut it out! If you keep this up, I'll just leave you here in Akihabara!
...You don't need to be caught up in this.
Kyousuke-shi...
Please. I'm worried about you.
Could you tell me what happened?
Uuhg...
Ky-Kyousuke-shi...I-I...
Yes. What is it?
I-It's time to pay the piper!
What happened!? Say it! I can help you!
Pay the piper? You're still talking funny?
U-uhg...Kyousuke-shi...
Kyousuke-shi, you're the only one who has worried this much over me...
U-Uhg...
What did you say...?
Saori!? I beg you, calm down!
U-Ugh...
Kyousuke-shi, I-I...
I finally have to pay the piper.
Well, you should pay the piper.
Kyousuke-shi... Now is a good time to intervene...
Hehe... Looks like the dream of us going down the red carpet isn't going to happen, after all...
Saori, look at reality. I never had that dream.
Reality...
The reality I am supposed to see... The cruel, severe reality...
